_readme: TRA-4261 — the repo-resident deploy hold read by scripts/render-redeploy.mjs. See ops/README-deploy-hold.md for the shape and the rules. This file is on the TIP, so it ships with whatever ships and is discoverable by `git log ops/deploy-hold.json` and by grep — not only by whoever happened to read a ticket thread. An empty `holds` array is the cleared state; DELETING the file is also the cleared state. Every gate in render-redeploy.mjs fails CLOSED, and so does this one: an unparseable file or a hold missing a required field REFUSES, it does not degrade to allowed. TRA-4262: `emits` is a SNAPSHOT OF A MOVING TIP — this script ships the tip, never a pin, so every hold must stamp the `enumeratedTip` its `emits` was taken against (a required field), and the enumeration is RE-TAKEN at clear time by the clearer. ⛔ TRA-4224 BASELINE CORRECTION: `git log <enumeratedTip>..origin/main` is NOT the whole check — it answers 'has anything landed since I last looked', which is the narrow question. A deploy moves the box from THE LIVE DEPLOYED PIN to the tip, so the window `emits` must cover is `git log <live pin>..origin/main`, with the live pin read off `GET /api/health/options-live` (`build.commit`) at clear time. Stamp it in `enumeratedFromLivePin`. Measured on the TRA-4217 hold 2026-09-01: four consecutive re-takes all measured forward and all missed the same 22-commit tail, 13 of them shipping server bytes. ✅ TRA-4268 SHIPPED THE INSTRUMENT: `enumeratedFromLivePin` is now a REQUIRED field (a hold without a READABLE one is BLIND and refuses, exactly like a missing `enumeratedTip`), it is parsed for a LEADING sha with the provenance after it, gate −1c asserts offline that it is an ancestor of `enumeratedTip` (a stamped window that does not exist is loud), the refusal PRINTS THE WINDOW `<enumeratedFromLivePin>..<enumeratedTip>` above emits[], and Gate 4 — which already holds the live pin, because gate −1 must stay offline — warns when the box has rebooted off the stamped baseline.

holds.reason: Deploying bqb1 right now RUNS THE TRA-4218 HEAL ON THREE OPEN REAL-MONEY ROWS. e1dbf341 is already an ancestor of origin/main and this script ships the TIP, not a pin (TRA-3888: a pinned --commit ages, drop it, ship the tip), so a deploy taken for any UNRELATED reason performs that migration on live money in production Tradier ***0154. The heal is not a code path that waits to be called: it runs at snapshot import, i.e. at boot, in OptionsAccount.importSnapshot (packages/server/src/options-account.ts, the TRA-4218 block). Whether that migration should run tonight is a board decision and it is NOT this gate's to make — it is the pending human_only card on TRA-4217 (`101f5a22` as of 2026-09-01T20:10Z; the previously cited `438ed4c5` EXPIRED UNANSWERED at 19:51:11Z — re-derive the live id, see clearedBy). This hold exists so that the decision is TAKEN rather than inherited by whoever deploys next.
emits: e1dbf341ae28c27159f884ffd0f21a568626f751 (TRA-4218) boots into OptionsAccount.importSnapshot and, for every open row whose exitErrorReason matches TRANSPORT_STRANDED_REASON_RE (5xx / 429 / 408 / fetch failure), DELETES closeRejectCount.
On the same rows it DELETES exitBreakerTrip where exitBreakerTrip.breaker === 'close_reject' (TRA-4225), which un-latches the close-reject breaker that is presently refusing the exits.

It then RE-ARMS through one backoff step: exitTransportFailCount = 1 and exitRetryNotBeforeMs = now + exitTransportBackoffMs(1). After that step expires the exit path is live again, so this is a change that can PLACE ORDERS, not merely a change to a counter.

Population as measured on 2026-08-31: ALL THREE open real-money OTM rows in production Tradier account ***0154, two of them under a BREACHED stop. There is no smaller blast radius available — the heal is unconditional on the rows that match.

This commit adds a second, text-independent term: the rejection branch stamps `closeRejectRefusalsOnly` on every increment, and the heal now requires its ABSENCE (= 'written by a build that could still inflate this counter with a 5xx' = legacy). THE RULE THIS CORRECTS, so the hole cannot be re-acquired: THE BASELINE FOR `emits` IS THE LIVE DEPLOYED PIN, NEVER THE ENUMERATOR'S STARTING TIP. `enumeratedTip` answers 'has anything landed SINCE I looked' — it was never able to answer 'does this list cover what the box GAINS', and the gate that grades it (`deployHoldStaleness`, gate −1b) compares `enumeratedTip..origin/main` only: the live pin never enters it, BY DESIGN, because gate −1 is offline and resolving the live pin needs the network. So the instrument cannot see this class and reported CURRENT/STALE truthfully while the list was structurally short by 22 commits. `enumeratedFromLivePin` below is the missing half; the instrument fix is TRA-4268.

`4dfe7486`'s own re-enumeration commit (this entry) SHIPS NO SERVER BYTE: it edits ops/deploy-hold.json only, so gate −1b will read STALE against `615aa315` for an ops-only delta. That is the mechanism working, not a new hazard.

THIS LIST GOES STALE THE NEXT TIME ANYONE PUSHES. It describes `092d087775dc..615aa315` — from the LIVE PIN, not from a tip. Before clearing, run BOTH `git log 615aa315..origin/main` (what landed since) AND `git log <live pin read off /api/health/options-live>..origin/main` (what the box actually gains), and re-enumerate — see clearedBy. render-redeploy.mjs prints only the first of those two in its refusal (TRA-4262), and only for a deploy somebody actually attempts.
